title: Sae Hee Wilson
text:
I’m a senior accounts payable accountant at a cybersecurity company, working across invoice approvals, credit card reconciliations, payment runs, and accruals in Zip and NetSuite (with past work in Coupa and SAP). A lot of my job ends up being the troubleshooter when systems or processes don’t line up, and the translator between cross-functional teams. I also work on process improvement and automation, including building a shared registry where our AP team logs every automation we run. Of the 55 entries so far, I’ve built 47: a mix of Python scripts, Excel macros and Power Query, Windows Scheduled Tasks, and Claude skills.
I’m finishing my master’s in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University. I don’t come from a technical background and picked most of it up on the job. The degree is how I’m putting those skills on paper and filling in the gaps along the way.
